9a) Pie chart& 3D Pie Chart, Bar Chart to demonstrate the percentage conveyance of various ways for traveling to office such as walking, car, bus, cycle, and train

# Install required package for 3D pie chart (run once if not installed)
# install.packages("plotrix")

library(plotrix)

# Data
modes <- c("Walking", "Car", "Bus", "Cycle", "Train")
percent <- c(15, 35, 20, 10, 20)  # example percentages

# Basic Pie Chart
pie(percent,
    labels = modes,
    main = "Ways of Traveling to Office (Pie Chart)",
    col = rainbow(length(modes)))

# 3D Pie Chart
pie3D(percent,
      labels = modes,
      explode = 0.1,
      main = "Ways of Traveling to Office (3D Pie Chart)",
      col = rainbow(length(modes)))

# Bar Chart
barplot(percent,
        names.arg = modes,
        main = "Ways of Traveling to Office (Bar Chart)",
        xlab = "Mode of Transport",
        ylab = "Percentage",
        col = "skyblue",
        ylim = c(0, 40))

**9b) Using box plots, Histogram, Line Graph, Multiple line graphs and scatter plot to demonstrate the relation between the cars speed and the distance taken to stop,

# Use built-in cars dataset
data(cars)

# 1. Box plots (speed and dist)
boxplot(cars$speed,
        main = "Boxplot of Speed",
        ylab = "Speed (mph)")

boxplot(cars$dist,
        main = "Boxplot of Stopping Distance",
        ylab = "Distance (ft)")

# 2. Histogram (speed and dist)
hist(cars$speed,
     main = "Histogram of Speed",
     xlab = "Speed (mph)",
     col = "lightblue")

hist(cars$dist,
     main = "Histogram of Stopping Distance",
     xlab = "Distance (ft)",
     col = "lightgreen")

# 3. Line graph (speed vs dist)
plot(x = cars$speed,
     y = cars$dist,
     type = "l",
     main = "Line Graph: Speed vs Distance",
     xlab = "Speed (mph)",
     ylab = "Distance (ft)")

# 4. Multiple line graphs (speed and dist over index)
plot(x = 1:nrow(cars),
     y = cars$speed,
     type = "l",
     col = "blue",
     main = "Multiple Line Graphs: Speed and Distance",
     xlab = "Observation Index",
     ylab = "Value")

lines(x = 1:nrow(cars),
      y = cars$dist,
      col = "red")

legend("topleft",
       legend = c("Speed", "Distance"),
       col = c("blue", "red"),
       lty = 1)

# 5. Scatter plot (relation between speed and dist)
plot(x = cars$speed,
     y = cars$dist,
     main = "Scatter Plot: Speed vs Distance",
     xlab = "Speed (mph)",
     ylab = "Distance (ft)",
     pch = 19,
     col = "darkgreen")
